design: 20 documented patient cases / 10 two-patient groups sharing exact question with different patient facts
evaluation_limitations: Medical facts are present in note-exposure stage; holdout refers to unseen tagged QA, not unseen facts.
Heldout QA can be factual or reasoning; each type is reported, and these should be analyzed separately.
Some anchors previously belonged to original AMNESIA holdout; the MED-003 train/test split is newly defined.
MED-000E was pretrained on notes and on some original train QA; not an unexposed base model.
This is a tiny, cherry-picked positive-control cohort, not an unbiased performance estimate.
Synthetic case codes are not natural patient identifiers; require factual and clinical review.
